_source: Events a reader named that Copilot's lists do not have. Built by tools/events/event_nodes.py exactly as Copilot's are: tellings checked against the Berean editors' notes, participants from the tellings, parts by passages. Doug, 2026-10-03: 'Israel receives the law' -- the event the temptation's third answer and the Sermon's 'you have heard that it was said' point back to; Deuteronomy is 'the second instance'.

primary.label: Exodus 19:1–24:18
primary.note: at Sinai: the LORD comes down on the mountain, speaks the commandments, gives the ordinances, and the covenant is confirmed

primary.label: Exodus 31:18
primary.note: the two tablets given to Moses on Mount Sinai, 'inscribed by the finger of God'

primary.label: Exodus 34:1–28
primary.note: the tablets given again, after the first were broken

primary.label: Deuteronomy 5:1–33
primary.note: retold at Moab: 'The LORD our God made a covenant with us at Horeb' (Deut 5:2)

primary.label: Deuteronomy 9:9–11
primary.note: Moses retells receiving the tablets: forty days and forty nights, no bread or water

secondary.label: Deuteronomy 4:10–14
secondary.note: retelling of the day at Horeb and the two tablets
secondary.line: Deuteronomy 4:10–14 (retelling of the day at Horeb and the two tablets)

secondary.label: Leviticus 26:46
secondary.note: reference: the laws 'that the LORD established between Himself and the Israelites through Moses on Mount Sinai'

secondary.label: Leviticus 27:34
secondary.note: reference: 'the commandments that the LORD gave to Moses for the Israelites on Mount Sinai'

secondary.label: Nehemiah 9:13–14
secondary.note: retelling: 'You came down on Mount Sinai ... You gave them just ordinances'

secondary.label: John 1:17
secondary.note: reference: 'the law was given through Moses'

secondary.label: Acts 7:38
secondary.note: reference: the angel 'who spoke to him on Mount Sinai', and 'he received living words'

secondary.label: Acts 7:53
secondary.note: reference: 'you who received the law ordained by angels'

secondary.label: Romans 5:13–14
secondary.note: reference: 'before the law was given' ... 'from Adam until Moses'

secondary.label: Romans 7:7
secondary.note: quotation of the commandment 'Do not covet'

secondary.label: Romans 9:4
secondary.note: reference: 'theirs the giving of the law'

secondary.label: Romans 13:8–10
secondary.note: quotation of the commandments and 'Love your neighbor as yourself'

secondary.label: Galatians 3:17–19
secondary.note: reference: 'The law that came 430 years later' ... 'Why then was the law given?'
